ambiguous_axis.description: <name>: <…> is turned off the grid's axes; use frame world or player.

ambiguous_circuit_holder.description: Device <reference_id> (<prefab_name>) holds <count> circuit holders (<…>); pass the reference id of the one you mean.

ambiguous_item.description: <count> of the trader's entries are <…>; give both name and prefab_name.

ambiguous_port.description: <name>: <prefab_name> <reference_id> is on <count> <network_kind> networks [<…>]; name one with {reference_id, port} (ports: <…>).

ambiguous_rocket.description: There are <count> rockets: give rocket_id, one of <…>.

atmosphere_not_found.description: '<name>': no thing, pipe network or atmosphere has id <id>.

busy.description: <maximum_pending> moves are already waiting for the next atmospherics tick (is the game paused?).

cancelled.description: Cancelled before it started. Nothing ran.

card_not_found.description: Reference id <value> is not a credit card.

card_not_usable.description: Credit card <reference_id> <where>. The game's sell takes goods from the card holder too and works only with a card a player carries or a vending machine holds.

cheat_not_armed.description: The connection's level allows cheat, but the owner has not approved it now. Nothing ran.

coils_short.description: Only <taken> of <cost> <…> could be taken for cell <cell>; the build stopped before it (what was taken is given back).

command_not_found.description: No console command is registered as '<key>'. Run the console command 'help' to list them.

command_not_ready.description: '<key>' needs an initialised GameManager. The console would not run it now: it would be queued and fired later during world init, out of band and with its output attributed to nothing. Retry once the game has finished loading.

confirm_required.description: A real run needs dry_run: false and confirm: true; nothing was changed.

contact_not_found.description: No trader contact has reference id <contact_id>.

device_not_found.description: Pin d<index>: device <id> is not visible <where>.

dish_not_ready.description: The dish has no horizontal pivot or pointing transform.

duplicate_id.description: The id is already in flight on this connection. Nothing ran.

engine_not_modelled.description: <…> is a <…>; the forecast flies only the Pumped Gas Engine (GovernedGasEngine), whose draw does not depend on pressure.

final_check_failed.description: The check once the tick had stopped found <count> problem(s); nothing was changed.

game_changed.description: A game member this method needs is missing in this game build.

game_timeout.description: The call was not started before its deadline. Nothing ran.

game_unavailable.description: The sidecar could not reach the mod (no pipe, or another client held it), or the mod took the call and sent no reply in time; in that case the call may still have run.

gateway_not_found.description: No StationGod Gateway has reference ID <id>.

has_color_state.description: <…> keeps its colour as an animator state; the spray can does not paint it.

ic_compile_error.description: The IC cannot be stepped while it has a compilation error.

in_vault_slot.description: <…> is in a slot of <…>; take it out or let the vault finish.

ingot_vault_changed.description: The IngotVault mod has changed: <…> is gone. This StationGod build needs an update for this IngotVault version; nothing was changed.

ingot_vault_mod_required.description: The vault tools need the IngotVault mod (Steam Workshop 3749011679), which is not loaded.

insufficient_available.description: Only <available> that the trader accepts are <…><after>.

internal_error.description: A bug. The method may have partly run.

invalid_argument.description: The arguments break the catalogue (version 2) or a tool's own reading (both versions). Nothing ran.

invalid_shape.description: Version 2 only: shape is malformed. Nothing ran.

job_not_found.description: No job <id> is running, queued or among the last <kept_jobs>.

joined_too_large.description: More than <maximum_members> atmospheres are joined; pass joined: false to move from the named one only.

logic_not_readable.description: Device does not expose <…> as readable.

logic_not_writable.description: Device <reference_id> does not expose <…> as writable.

long_piece.description: <prefab_name> <reference_id> is a long straight; start from one of its cells with <name>.at, or make it the target (to), where the route may join any of its cells.

lua_chip_unsupported.description: A Lua chip cannot <action>: it runs a whole tick(dt) per game tick, with no line to stop at. Use restart to run it again from the start, or set_ic_source to change it.

materials_short.description: Only <taken> of <charge> <…> could be taken for this piece; it was swapped and the run stopped after it.

memory_not_readable.description: Device <reference_id> does not expose readable memory.

memory_not_writable.description: Device <reference_id> does not expose writable memory.

mod_missing.description: BlueprintMod has not set up its Blueprints folder yet; pass an absolute path.

no_atmosphere.description: <name> (<id>) holds no gas or liquid: it has no internal atmosphere, is not a pipe or a landing pad piece, is connected to no pipe network and has nothing with an atmosphere in its slots.

no_camera.description: near: there is no player camera to look from (a dedicated server has none); pass near.

no_crosshair_hit.description: near: the look ray hits nothing within 20 m; pass near.

no_cursor.description: The game has no placement cursor for <prefab_name>.

no_face.description: <name>: the look ray hits <point>, which is not on a 2 m face plane; look straight at a wall, floor or ceiling.

no_flight_log.description: This rocket has no flight log: start one with action start.

no_fuel_line.description: No engine on this rocket has a pipe network on its input: there is nothing to burn.

no_kit.description: No coil or kit places <…> pieces.

no_line_shader.description: This build of the game has no built-in shader to draw lines with.

no_local_player.description: There is no local player in this game (a dedicated server has none).

no_programmable_chip.description: Device <reference_id> (<prefab_name>) keeps its memory on a programmable chip and has none installed.

no_reagents.description: <…> carries no reagents; the vault would destroy it and store nothing.

no_room.description: No vending machine on the pad's network, nor the card holder, has an empty tradable slot.

no_run_between.description: No run of <noun> pieces joins <reference_id> and <reference_id> by the model's links.

no_save_folder.description: No save is loaded, so there is no folder for the CSV.

no_target.description: The rocket stands on its pad with no target: give 'to' (a node's name or code).

no_xray_material.description: Neither the T-Ray SPU's material nor a built-in shader to draw through walls with was found.

node_not_found.description: No space-map node is called '<wanted>': give its name, its map code, or 'pad'.

not_a_lua_chip.description: restart is for Lua chips; an IC10 chip restarts at line 0 when set_ic_source writes it.

not_a_plant.description: <…> (<…>) is not a plant, seed or plant produce.

not_a_segment.description: The pieces meet the rest of the world at <count> cell(s) [<…>], not two: a reroute replaces a run with one way in and one way out. Name a segment without branches or dead ends.

not_a_vault.description: <…> (<id>) is not an Ingot Vault or a Remote Vault.

not_connectable.description: <…> (<…>) is not a pipe, cable, chute or device, so it has no connection ends.

not_host.description: This game is a multiplayer client; only the host moves gas.

not_ic_housing.description: Circuit holder <holder_id> (<prefab_name>) is a <name>; only an IC Housing's pins can be set.

not_in_room.description: Thing <id> is not in a closed room: its cell is outside.

not_in_vault.description: The vault holds no <…>; it holds <…>.

not_logic_device.description: Pin d<index>: <id> is a <…>, not a logic device a pin can hold.

not_movable.description: <…> is not an item that fits in a slot.

not_on_data_network.description: Pin d<index>: device <id> (<…>) is not on IC Housing <reference_id>'s data network, so the chip would not reach it through the pin. Connect it to the housing's data network, or pass allow_off_network to store it anyway.

not_on_network.description: <prefab_name> <reference_id> is not on network <wanted>; its <noun> networks: [<…>].

not_paintable.description: <…> refused the paint (its SetCustomColor is not implemented).

not_ready.description: The world grid is not loaded.

not_solar_panel.description: Reference id <id> is not a solar panel.

not_vault_material.description: <…> is not something the vault imports: it keeps ingots, ores and ices only.

nothing_to_move.description: The source holds none of the requested gases.

out_of_range.description: Gene <gene>: <value> is outside the game's range <minimum> to <maximum>; pass force to write it anyway.

paint_failed.description: <…> still shows colour index <now> after painting it <color_index>.

partial_merge.description: Part of a stack can only go into an empty slot; the game has no partial merge.

permission_denied.description: The method, at the arguments given, needs a higher level than the connection has; or run_console_command was asked to run a stationgod command. Nothing ran.

plant_not_found.description: Nothing with reference id <id> is a plant.

planted.description: <…> is growing in <…>: a player never takes a plant out whole, only harvests its fruit or seeds once it is mature or seeding (see plants) or clears it.

prefab_missing.description: No item prefab <prefab_hash> exists to make.

protocol_error.description: A message the protocol does not allow: not a JSON object, unknown type, unknown top-level key, a call before welcome, a repeated hello, sign-in not finished within 10 seconds of connecting. The connection is closed after the reply.

refused.description: '<name>': atmosphere <reference_id> is a <mode> atmosphere. A single world cell is not moved to or from; name its room ({"room_id"} or {"room_of"}) instead.

reply_too_large.description: The reply would exceed shape.max_bytes or limits.max_reply_bytes. The method ran.

request_too_large.description: A message longer than limits.max_request_bytes. The connection is closed.

rocket_not_found.description: No rocket has the id <value>: give a rocket's, its rocket network's or any of its parts' reference id.

same_joined_set.description: 'to' is joined to 'from' (the game mixes them every tick), so the gas would flow straight back. Pass joined: false to move between them anyway.

save_started.description: A save started while waiting for the game tick; nothing was changed. Run it again.

sell_separately.description: An earlier line of this call sold goods the game would take again for this entry (they leave their slots only at the end of the frame); sell this entry in a call of its own.

shutting_down.description: The mod is stopping or the world is unloading; the call was not started.

slot_occupied.description: <…> already has <…> planted; a plant slot holds one plant.

slot_refuses.description: The game has no plant that <…> grows into.

source_too_large.description: The Lua source is <…> characters; the limit is <…>. Split it into library chips (--@module) and require them.

stack_full.description: <…> holds <quantity> of <max_quantity>; <quantity> more do not fit.

subject_not_found.description: Rule <id> selects <set>; none of those around the place given is the subject named.

subscription_limit.description: A subscription would exceed a per-subscription, connection or global limit; poll instead.

terraforming_mod_required.description: Removing gas from the planet needs Terraforming Reloaded: the stock game keeps the planet's air read-only, so a removal would not last.

thing_not_found.description: No thing, pipe or landing pad network or thing's atmosphere has reference id <id>. Room and world air cannot be looked up this way.

tick_held.description: An earlier job's atmosphere work ran past its time limit and is still running; the tick stays held until it ends. Try again, or pass wait: true to queue the run.

tick_not_stopped.description: The game tick did not stop in time; nothing was changed.

too_many_in_flight.description: More calls in flight than limits.max_in_flight. Nothing ran.

transfer_not_found.description: No move <id> is waiting or among the last <kept_outcomes> applied.

unauthorized.description: Bad or missing key proof, unknown client name, auth.client not equal to hello.client.name, an anonymous TCP connection, or a key not allowed on this transport; today also the TCP bridge refusing the shared secret. The connection is closed.

unit_out_of_range.description: <…> has <count> gene set(s), the top one last: unit must be 0 to <…>.

unknown_gas.description: '<item>' is not a gas name as atmosphere_contents reports them (Oxygen, Nitrogen, CarbonDioxide, LiquidOxygen, Steam...).

unknown_subscription.description: unsubscribe of an id this connection does not have.

vault_display_slot.description: Slot <index> of <…> only shows the vault's store; use vault_deposit to store items.

vault_not_connected.description: Remote Vault <id> reaches no vault (<connection>): it needs exactly one Ingot Vault on its data network.

vault_unpowered.description: <…> (<reference_id>) is <…>; the vault neither imports nor vends then. Nothing was changed.

would_burst.description: '<name>' <verb> <predicted> kPa against a limit of <…> kPa (<member>: <max_kpa> kPa across, <outside_kpa> kPa outside). Pass force to move it anyway.
